senses.gloss: (cmp. Arab. ḳaran junxit &c.) to join, harness, put to.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 3:4:4">Y. Kidd. III, 64ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ זבונה וכ׳</he> the trader put the beasts to and went off; [Var. <cite ref="S02142"><he>קרץ</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="S02143"><he>קְרַץ</he> II</cite>].
